verdict.rationale: The skills ship as SKILL.md folders installable into `.claude/skills/` (docs-3). The docs also say any single SKILL.md can be pasted into a chat without Claude Code and still run as a mode (docs-2), which hints at portability beyond one vendor's tooling. Nothing in the pack says the skills conform to the open Agent Skills specification or have been validated in other tools, and the paste-into-chat path is a manual workaround rather than spec-level compatibility. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of Agent Skills spec conformance (frontmatter fields, folder layout), documented installation in non-Claude agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-tool validity.
